rationale: Task requires identifying high-cost claims (top 10% by paid_amount, i.e., 90th percentile) using information available at claim submission. Split 0.25 for quarter holdout per task spec. Target threshold computed on train_only to prevent leakage (leakage noted in task tags). Feature set includes clinical and claim attributes available at submission (claim_type, diagnosis, procedure category, place of service, provider specialty, network status, flags, amounts), excluding identifiers and target-derived fields. Preprocessing fits on train_only and applies standard scaling to benefit logistic regression. Models include logistic_regression plus random_forest (tree-based) per task requirement. Report includes no_operational_use caveat (skill evolved_run_012_005) because model scores are analytical tools for identifying claims requiring review and must not be used operationally without clinical validation and governance review. cite_artifacts=true enforces reproducibility discipline.
